Name: SNES Foraging Mobile Sprouts
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
Here's some walkin plants for your coop. They'll give you forage items. This is a bit of a quickie mod but something I was wanting to do. Let me know if there are particular problems with it.

I know they tend to stand in a sort of in-between step frame but that's how they look in their source game during battle so I decided not to "fix" it. They're just posing, it's cool. 

Seaworthy Mobile Sprout can swim, but it just becomes a shadow (cuz it's down on the floor of the water harvesting seaweed, clearly)

Here's the plants and what they produce:

fiber": "Fibrous Mobile Sprout",
white algae": "Tough Mobile Sprout",
horseradish": "Hardy Mobile Sprout",
winter root": "Rugged Mobile Sprout",
fiddlehead": "Formidable Mobile Sprout",
seaweed": "Seaworthy Mobile Sprout",
leek": "Tenacious Mobile Sprout",
spring onion": "Persistent Mobile Sprout",
holly": "Seasoned Mobile Sprout",
snow yam": "Robust Mobile Sprout",
cave carrot": "Burly Mobile Sprout",
hazelnut": "Stubborn Mobile Sprout",

Version 2 has added a second set of 6, bringing us up to 12 of these fellas. Between this and my other mods, you can get most of the forage in the vanilla game from alternative sources. I've also added support for i18n, so if anyone cares to translate, please feel free.

Downloads.Description: 12 mobile sprout coop animals to forage for you. added i18n support.
